question_answered.description: true if the corpus contains sufficient evidence to answer the theoretical question.

answer_summary.description: Narrative summary of findings. What did the scan reveal? 2-4 sentences.

relevant_segments.description: Segments relevant to the theoretical question. Empty if none found.

exact_quote.description: Exact verbatim quote. Truncate to ~300 words max.

is_relevant.description: true if this segment provides meaningful evidence for the theoretical question.

theoretical_contribution.description: What this segment contributes: confirms, expands gradient, reveals new property/condition, or contradicts assumption.

suggested_coding_action.description: If this segment should be coded differently, what action to take.

no_evidence_gap.description: Present only if no relevant segments were found.

gap_description.description: What kind of evidence is missing.

recommended_data_collection.description: What type of data to collect.

emergent_insights.description: Unexpected patterns or connections observed during the scan.
